name: Tex Miller
tagline: Cameron's family burger spot since the 1930s.
about: Tex Miller is a family-run burger spot at 104 N Fannin Ave that has been feeding Cameron since the 1930s.
The menu sticks to the classics: hamburgers, cheeseburgers, chili dogs and Frito pie.
